I am keeping the add modest because the stock has already moved up and I want to avoid overconcentration, but increasing from roughly 3.1% to 5.0% better aligns position size with catalyst quality.

recent_trades.summary: Buy a 3.5% RTX position on the new $24.4B Standard Missile 6 contract and strengthening aerospace aftermarket outlook.

recent_trades.summary: Doubling the RTX position to 10% to capitalize on the new $24.4B missile contract and escalating Middle East tensions.

Upsizing the position maximizes our exposure to this immediate thematic tailwind.

Trimming a small portion preserves exposure while improving portfolio catalyst quality and sector positioning under a geopolitical tape that currently favors defense more than diversified industrial automation.
